  blockers(): string[] {

    return this.lists[side].items

I added `blockers()` to the `Handover` class, just before `checklist(side)`. It reads the `out` list while the phase is `checking` and the `back` list while it is `returned`. Otherwise it returns `[]`. It keeps only items with `must` true and a state of `todo` or `fault`, and returns their codes in checklist order without changing anything.

I couldn't see the file, so I anchored the edit on the line `  checklist(side: Side): Checklist {`, taken from the outline. If that line's text or indentation differs, the edit will be refused. I also assumed the class stores its phase in `this.state` and its checklists in `this.lists`, as the outline shows.
